findings.title: Avoid decoding the full document twice per delta
findings.message: Decode builds a map containing every rune boundary, but its decoded result is discarded here. applyInput subsequently decodes the expanded snapshot again. At the new 4 MiB document limit, an ASCII document requires roughly four million map entries per decode, creating substantial allocation and garbage-collection overhead for every small native edit.
findings.suggestion: Return the validated RuneUpdate alongside the expanded update and reuse it in applyInput, or validate the requested offsets without constructing a full boundary map here so that Decode runs only once.
